name: BKF Chair
designer: Antonio Bonet, Juan Kurchan, Jorge Ferrari Hardoy
description: Also known as the Butterfly chair, it is the most internationally recognized piece of Argentine design.

name: W Chair
description: First made for the construction site of the House over the Stream in Mar del Plata. Its curved frame relies on the elasticity of steel.

name: Madrid Chair
description: A lounge chair designed by two architects and exhibited at the Museum of Architecture and Design of Buenos Aires.

name: Stilka Armchair
description: Designed for Stilka, one of the key Argentine furniture companies of the period.

name: LP Chair
description: A stackable chair from the early career of one of the main figures of Argentine industrial design.

name: Dining Chair
description: A dining chair by Churba, whose company also brought international designers to Argentina.
